source.method: Figma MCP get_design_context + read-only Plugin API geometry, exact vector paths and recursive variable aliases

observations.note: Checkbox-icon contains only Box/Mark, not a label, native input, hit-area or group. Actual18 variants: three types x three sizes x enabled/disabled.
type checked/unchecked/indeterminate is independent of enum state enabled/disabled. Generated prototype state Boolean is not the Figma definition or product API.
Marks are local VECTORs, not AgentHubIcon instances. Check and minus both use1px centered round strokes in all three sizes; minus path height0 still has visible stroke.

Checked/indeterminate enabled Box has no paint in strokes even though strokeWeight=1. Disabled selected/mixed restores1px inside#DDD. Native input focus must remain outside the clipped visual indicator.

Twelve supplied whole Box+Mark SVGs are preserved with native12/16/20 dimensions and provenance/hash in checkbox.assets.json. Use as decorative visuals or compare an existing exact implementation; do not treat the SVG as a native checkbox or add duplicate Box/Mark.
